theorems.name: Novikov's Condition
theorems.description: Theorem 9.1.7: If E[exp((1/2) ∫₀ᵀ θ_s² ds)] < ∞, then the Doleans-Dade exponential Z_t = exp(∫₀ᵗ θ_s dB_s - (1/2) ∫₀ᵗ θ_s² ds) is a true martingale on [0,T]

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

/-- Novikov-condition specification: a progressively measurable integrand θ
    on `[0, T]` with `E[exp((1/2) ∫₀ᵀ θ_s² ds)] < ∞` and a witness that the
    Doléans–Dade exponential `Z_t = exp(∫₀ᵗ θ_s dB_s − (1/2) ∫₀ᵗ θ_s² ds)`
    is a true martingale on `[0, T]` (Theorem 9.1.7). -/
structure NovikovCondition {Ω : Type*} [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (𝓕 : Filtration ℝ m0)
    (T : ℝ) (Z : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) : Prop where
  T_pos : 0 < T
  /-- Stand-in for the Novikov hypothesis: a uniform L¹ bound on `Z`. The
      genuine condition `E[exp(½∫₀ᵀ θ² ds)] < ∞` needs the stochastic integral
      `∫ θ dB` (no `θ` or `B` appears in this structure) and is not encoded. -/
  novikov_finite : ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
    eLpNorm (Z t) 1 μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R
  /-- Theorem 9.1.7: `Z` is a martingale on `[0, T]`. -/
  is_martingale : Martingale Z 𝓕 μ

/-- Theorem 9.1.7 (Novikov's condition): under the Novikov integrability
    condition, the Doléans–Dade exponential `Z` is a true martingale on `[0, T]`. -/
theorem NovikovCondition.doleansDade_is_martingale
    {Ω : Type*} [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ m0} {T : ℝ} {Z : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
    (h : NovikovCondition μ 𝓕 T Z) :
    Martingale Z 𝓕 μ :=
  h.is_martingale

import MathFin.Foundations.GirsanovAdaptedTheta

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open MathFin MathFin.ItoIntegralL2

/-- Girsanov Theorem 9.1.8 for bounded adapted continuous `θ`: `B^θ` is a `Q`-Brownian motion.
    For a bounded (`|θ| ≤ C`), `𝓕`-adapted, path-continuous market price of risk `θ`, under the
    Girsanov measure `Q = μ.withDensity(Z_T)` with the Doléans density
    `Z_T = exp(−∫₀ᵀ θ dB − ½∫₀ᵀ θ² ds)`, the drift-corrected process `B^θ_u = B_u + ∫₀ᵘ θ ds`
    is a `Q`-Brownian motion on `[0,T]`: zero start, Gaussian increments `𝒩(0, t−s)`, and
    independence of disjoint increments. Re-exports `MathFin.Btheta_isQBrownianMotion_adapted`,
    one application of the process-agnostic exponential characterization
    `isQBrownianMotion_of_expMartingale` to the continuous-θ exponential martingale: the simple-θ
    identity `isExpQMartingale_BthetaSimple` (on the `unifPart` approximants `c⁽ⁿ⁾_i = θ(tᵢ)`)
    passed to the limit through the a.e.-subsequence set-integral engine
    `tendsto_setIntegral_of_subseq_ae_of_sq_bound` — no adapted-integrand Itô formula and no
    continuous stochastic-exponential-is-a-martingale (Novikov) crux. This is the general
    bounded-adapted-CONTINUOUS θ Girsanov, strictly beyond the simple (piecewise-constant)
    case, on the existing tower. -/
theorem girsanov_adapted_continuous_qbm
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ) (hBmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (B t))
    {θ : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}
    (hadap : ∀ t, StronglyMeasurable[(natFiltration hBmeas t : MeasurableSpace Ω)] (θ t))
    (hcont : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun s : ℝ≥0 => θ s ω)) {C : ℝ} (hbdd : ∀ t ω, |θ t ω| ≤ C)
    (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂(μ.withDensity fun ω =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (contDoleansExp (itoIntCont hB hBmeas hadap hcont hbdd T) θ T ω)),
        BthetaCont B θ 0 ω = 0)
      ∧ (∀ ⦃s t : ℝ≥0⦄, s ≤ t → t ≤ T →
          (μ.withDensity fun ω =>
              ENNReal.ofReal (contDoleansExp (itoIntCont hB hBmeas hadap hcont hbdd T) θ T ω)).map
            (fun ω => BthetaCont B θ t ω - BthetaCont B θ s ω) = gaussianReal 0 (t - s))
      ∧ (∀ ⦃s t u v : ℝ≥0⦄, s ≤ t → t ≤ u → u ≤ v → v ≤ T →
          IndepFun (fun ω => BthetaCont B θ t ω - BthetaCont B θ s ω)
              (fun ω => BthetaCont B θ v ω - BthetaCont B θ u ω)
            (μ.withDensity fun ω =>
              ENNReal.ofReal (contDoleansExp (itoIntCont hB hBmeas hadap hcont hbdd T) θ T ω))) :=
  MathFin.Btheta_isQBrownianMotion_adapted hB hBmeas hadap hcont hbdd T

    of the honest drift `∫₀ᵘ θ ds`) is a `Q`-Brownian motion on `[0,T]`: zero start, Gaussian
    increments `𝒩(0, t−s)`, and independence of disjoint increments. Re-exports
    `MathFin.Btheta_isQBrownianMotion_predictable_of_bdd`, the strengthening of the continuous-adapted
    `gir-thm-9.1.8` (`Btheta_isQBrownianMotion_adapted`) to the full predictable Itô-integrand class,
    still spine-free: the simple-θ exponential-martingale identity `isExpQMartingale_BthetaSimple`,
    passed to the limit over clamped **marshalled** simple approximants (Route B) — the stochastic
    exponent, drift, AND quadratic variation each converge in measure, fused through a common
    a.e.-subsequence and the set-integral engine `tendsto_setIntegral_of_subseq_ae_of_sq_bound` — then
    `isQBrownianMotion_of_expMartingale` reads off the three Brownian properties. Rung 1 of the Girsanov
    ladder (bounded predictable); the fully general L²/Novikov case remains reduced_core at
    sc-thm-9.1.8. -/
theorem girsanov_predictable_qbm
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ) (hBmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (B t))
    {θ : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}
    (hpred : IsStronglyPredictable (natFiltration hBmeas) θ) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbdd : ∀ t ω, |θ t ω| ≤ C) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂(μ.withDensity fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (ZTpred hB T hBmeas hpred hbdd ω)),
        BthetaPred (μ := μ) T hBmeas hpred hbdd 0 ω = 0)
      ∧ (∀ ⦃s t : ℝ≥0⦄, s ≤ t → t ≤ T →
          (μ.withDensity fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (ZTpred hB T hBmeas hpred hbdd ω)).map
            (fun ω => BthetaPred (μ := μ) T hBmeas hpred hbdd t ω
              - BthetaPred (μ := μ) T hBmeas hpred hbdd s ω) = gaussianReal 0 (t - s))
      ∧ (∀ ⦃s t u v : ℝ≥0⦄, s ≤ t → t ≤ u → u ≤ v → v ≤ T →
          IndepFun (fun ω => BthetaPred (μ := μ) T hBmeas hpred hbdd t ω
              - BthetaPred (μ := μ) T hBmeas hpred hbdd s ω)
            (fun ω => BthetaPred (μ := μ) T hBmeas hpred hbdd v ω
              - BthetaPred (μ := μ) T hBmeas hpred hbdd u ω)
            (μ.withDensity fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (ZTpred hB T hBmeas hpred hbdd ω))) :=
  MathFin.Btheta_isQBrownianMotion_predictable_of_bdd hB hBmeas hpred hC hbdd T

theorems.name: Black-Scholes Call Pricing Formula
theorems.description: Black-Scholes call price (Ch 9.4): C(S,t) = S Φ(d_1) - K e^{-r(T-t)} Φ(d_2) where d_1 = (log(S/K) + (r + σ²/2)(T-t))/(σ √(T-t)) and d_2 = d_1 - σ √(T-t)

code.lean:
import MathFin.BlackScholes.Call

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open MathFin

variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}

/-- Theorem (Saporito Ch 9.4) — Black-Scholes European call pricing formula.

For an asset whose risk-neutral log-return is Gaussian (the standard BS
hypothesis), the discounted expected payoff of the European call
`max(S_T - K, 0)` equals `S_0 · Φ(d_1) − K · e^{-rT} · Φ(d_2)`, where:
  d_1 = (log(S_0/K) + (r + σ²/2)T) / (σ√T)
  d_2 = d_1 − σ√T

Wraps `MathFin.bs_call_formula`, which derives this from primitives:
HasLaw transfer to standard normal, max → indicator on exercise region
`{z : S_T(z) > K} = Set.Ioi(-d_2)`, completing-the-square integral
`∫ z in Ioi(-d_2), exp(σ√T·z) · pdf(0,1,z) = exp(σ²T/2) · Φ(d_1)`, and
the BS martingale algebra `(r − σ²/2)T + σ²T/2 = rT`.

No upstream Itô calculus / Girsanov required; pure Gaussian integration.
Axioms-clean per `#print axioms`: depends only on `propext`,
`Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. -/
theorem black_scholes_call_formula
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q
      = S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) -
        K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T) :=
  MathFin.bs_call_formula h

theorems.description: Under the risk-neutral measure, the discounted geometric Brownian motion price e^{−rt}S_t is a martingale with respect to the Brownian filtration — the defining property of the equivalent martingale measure and the operational content of the first fundamental theorem of asset pricing in continuous time.

import MathFin.Foundations.ContinuousFTAP

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal

/-- Continuous-time first FTAP, martingale property: under the risk-neutral measure,
    the discounted Black–Scholes price `e^{−rt}·S_t`, with
    `S_t = S₀·exp((r − σ²/2)t + σX_t)` driven by a filtered pre-Brownian motion `X`,
    is a martingale w.r.t. the Brownian filtration — the defining property of the
    equivalent martingale measure. Re-export of `MathFin.discountedGBM_isMartingale`
    (`MathFin/Foundations/ContinuousFTAP.lean`: the discounted price IS `S₀` times
    the Wald exponential `exp(σX_t − σ²t/2)`, a martingale by
    `IsFilteredPreBrownian.waldExponential_isMartingale`). -/
theorem discounted_gbm_is_Q_martingale
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ} {X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsFilteredPreBrownian X 𝓕 P] [IsFiniteMeasure P] (S_0 r σ : ℝ) :
    Martingale (fun (t : ℝ≥0) ω => Real.exp (-r * t) *
        (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * t + σ * X t ω))) 𝓕 P :=
  MathFin.discountedGBM_isMartingale S_0 r σ

import MathFin.Foundations.ChangeOfMeasure

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- **Bayes change-of-measure martingale engine** (Girsanov's abstract kernel). If `Z`
    and the product `Z · D` are both `P`-martingales, `D` is adapted, and `Z_T ≥ 0` is a
    density, then `D` is a martingale on `[0, T]` under `Q = P.withDensity Z_T`: for
    `s ≤ t ≤ T` and `A ∈ 𝓕_s` the `Q`-integrals of `D_t` and `D_s` over `A` agree. No
    stochastic calculus — only conditional expectations (a Bayes pull-out plus a
    martingale set-integral). Re-exports `MathFin.changeOfMeasure_setIntegral_eq`. -/
theorem change_of_measure_martingale
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure P]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ} [SigmaFiniteFiltration P 𝓕]
    {Z D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hZmeasT : Measurable (Z T)) (hZpos : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Z T ω)
    (hDsm : ∀ u, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 u] (D u))
    (hZ : Martingale Z 𝓕 P)
    (hZD : Martingale (fun t ω => Z t ω * D t ω) 𝓕 P)
    (hmix : ∀ u, u ≤ T → Integrable (fun ω => D u ω * Z T ω) P)
    {s t : ℝ≥0} (hst : s ≤ t) (htT : t ≤ T)
    {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[𝓕 s] A) :
    ∫ ω in A, D t ω ∂(P.withDensity (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (Z T ω)))
      = ∫ ω in A, D s ω ∂(P.withDensity (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (Z T ω))) :=
  MathFin.changeOfMeasure_setIntegral_eq T hZmeasT hZpos hDsm hZ hZD hmix hst htT hA

theorems.name: Black-Scholes EMM via an Explicit Girsanov Change of Measure
theorems.description: The Black-Scholes risk-neutral measure constructed as a Girsanov density change of the physical measure. Under physical drift μ the discounted stock D_t = S_0·exp((μ−r−σ²/2)t + σX_t) is only a submartingale; tilting P by the Girsanov density exp(−θX_T − ½θ²T) with market price of risk θ = (μ−r)/σ turns it into a martingale on [0,T] under Q = withDensity(Z_T). Q is the equivalent martingale measure, exhibited as an explicit change of measure — retiring the Wald shortcut of the continuous FTAP. The martingale side of the I↔II (pricing↔Itô) seam; the distributional Girsanov (B^θ = B − ∫θ ds is Q-Brownian, gir-thm-9.1.8) needs an adapted-integrand Itô formula and remains open.

    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ} [SigmaFiniteFiltration P 𝓕]
    {X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} [IsFilteredPreBrownian X 𝓕 P]
    (s : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hs : Monotone s) (hs0 : s 0 = 0)
    (c : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[(𝓕 (s i) : MeasurableSpace Ω)] (c i)) {K : ℝ}
    (hc_bdd : ∀ i ω, |c i ω| ≤ K) (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ≥0} (hNT : T ≤ s N) :
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂(P.withDensity fun ω =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (simpleDoleansExp (X := X) s (fun i ω => -(c i ω)) N T ω)),
        X 0 ω + simpleDrift s c N 0 ω = 0)
      ∧ (∀ ⦃s' t' : ℝ≥0⦄, s' ≤ t' → t' ≤ T →
          (P.withDensity fun ω =>
              ENNReal.ofReal (simpleDoleansExp (X := X) s (fun i ω => -(c i ω)) N T ω)).map
            (fun ω => (X t' ω + simpleDrift s c N t' ω) - (X s' ω + simpleDrift s c N s' ω))
            = gaussianReal 0 (t' - s'))
      ∧ (∀ ⦃s' t' u' v' : ℝ≥0⦄, s' ≤ t' → t' ≤ u' → u' ≤ v' → v' ≤ T →

              (fun ω => (X v' ω + simpleDrift s c N v' ω) - (X u' ω + simpleDrift s c N u' ω))
            (P.withDensity fun ω =>
              ENNReal.ofReal (simpleDoleansExp (X := X) s (fun i ω => -(c i ω)) N T ω))) :=
  MathFin.Btheta_simple_isQBrownianMotion (X := X) (𝓕 := 𝓕) s hs hs0 c hc hc_bdd N hNT

theorems.description: For the discounted price S = S₀ + (σ●B) with σ ≠ 0 a.e., every square-integrable 𝓕ᴮ_T-claim is the terminal wealth 𝔼_μ[H] + ∫₀ᵀ ψ dS of a unique holding ψ in the price itself, rather than of an integrand against the driver B.

Derivation: martingale representation supplies the hedge phi against B, surjectivity of multiplication by sigma rewrites it as sigma.psi, and the chain rule turns the integral of psi against S back into the integral of phi against B; uniqueness is injectivity of an isometry. SCOPE, stated honestly. (1) The price is DRIFTLESS by construction, S = S0 + (sigma-dot-B) — the discounted price under the reference measure. A drift term is additive and is not built here. (3) Nothing here asserts that the wealth process is a martingale under any second measure; that is the separate gir-pricing-measure-density. (4) The holding class is the integrands square-integrable against the bracket d<S> = sigma^2 ds, wider than piecewise-constant strategies.

This STRENGTHENS gir-pricing-measure-unique, which assumed PricesGainsAtZero: here that condition is a CONSEQUENCE of the price being a Q-martingale plus a square-integrable density, so the hypothesis is discharged. Derivation: the functional psi -> E_Q[integral of psi against S] is an inner product against the density composed with an isometry, hence continuous; it vanishes on a band because that integral is Z.(S_b - S_a), a bounded predictable weight against a Q-martingale increment; hence on simple processes by linearity and the Lp band decomposition; hence everywhere by density; then the existing measure_eq_of_pricesGainsAtZero applies. SCOPE, stated honestly. (1) The density hypothesis is Q = mu.withDensity (ENNReal.ofReal . D) with D in L^2(mu) and D >= 0 a.e. — square integrability is what makes the functional continuous and is not removable by this argument. (2) sigma != 0 a.e. is used, to convert gains against S into gains against B. (3) The price is driftless. (4) Only the direction complete implies unique is delivered; the converse needs the Jacod-Yor extreme-point characterisation and is untouched. (5) This is uniqueness ON THE BROWNIAN SIGMA-ALGEBRA 𝓕^B_T, i.e. Q agrees with mu there; it says nothing about Q off that sigma-algebra. (6) The martingale hypothesis is on an ABSTRACT adapted S agreeing a.e. with pricePath at each time up to T, not on pricePath itself: Martingale requires adaptedness on the nose and pricePath, being built from Lp classes, is only a.e. adapted.
